name: American Maltese Association Rescue (AMAR)
region_note: SMALL BREED / CHIHUAHUA / DACHSHUND / YORKIE / MALTESE
notes: Maltese; a volunteer rescue that takes Maltese surrendered by their owners and calls itself NYC-based. It took over the dogs of Metropolitan Maltese Rescue, which closed after 29 years. Write to a coordinator through its contact page: https://www.americanmalteserescue.org/contact
